lastCompletedStory.title: Clean unused locals/params in test/supervisor, test/release, test/integration

nextStoryContext: All 34 TS6133/TS6196 violations under test/supervisor/, test/release/, test/integration/ are removed (verified via `bunx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters 2>&1 | grep -E '^test/(supervisor|release|integration)/'`, now zero output). Breakdown: 3 whole dead test-helper functions deleted outright (makeOpts in merge-watch.test.ts and sidecar-loop.test.ts, makeSpawnFn in post-merge.test.ts -- confirmed zero call sites via grep before deleting); several unused type-only imports trimmed (MergeWatchOptions, ReadPrd/WritePrd/ReadHandoff/ClockFn/IsPaneAlive/ReviewDispatch/WriteSessionMarker, GenUuid x2, PlanMutexState, MAX_ITERATIONS); a few unused node:fs imports trimmed (writeFileSync/readFileSync/existsSync, mkdirSync); the rest were required-signature callback params (SpawnFn/GitSpawnFn/IssueFileSpawnFn/PostMergeFn/CloseIssueOnMainFn 'cmd'/'opts'/'cwd' params) underscore-prefixed rather than deleted per the required-signature rule, plus one dead 'fn' local and one dead 'result' local (side-effect-free, dropped the assignment but kept the await/call). Zero new @ts-ignore/@ts-expect-error introduced (verified via git diff grep). Full check:all spine green (4529 pass / 0 fail, typecheck/lint/file-size/debt-markers/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md all ok). Flags stay OFF in tsconfig.json for this story (US-004 flips them). Remaining scope for US-003: ~26 TS6133/TS6196 violations still exist under other test/** paths NOT touched by this story (grep pattern: `bunx tsc --noEmit --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters 2>&1 | grep -E '^test/' | grep -vE '^test/(supervisor|release|integration)/'`) -- get the current per-file list with that exact command at the start of US-003.
